title: (RHEA-2015:1582) Update Satellite 5 to include Red Hat Access Insights
portal_summary:
The Red Hat Access Insights service is now generally available for Red Hat
Satellite 5.7.
portal_synopsis: Update Satellite 5 to include Red Hat Access Insights
portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata
relevant to your system have been applied.

For details on how to apply this update, refer to:

https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
portal_description:
Red Hat Satellite is a systems management tool for Linux-based infrastructures.
It allows for provisioning, remote management and monitoring of multiple Linux
deployments with a single, centralized tool.

This enhancement update adds the powerful new Red Hat Access Insights service to
Red Hat Satellite 5.7. With Red Hat Access Insights, subscribers will be able to
quickly identify key risks to stability, security, or performance in Red Hat
Enterprise Linux. (BZ#1217737)

More information about installing and configuring Red Hat Access Insights is
available at: https://access.redhat.com/insights/getting-started/satellite/5/

All users who require the Red Hat Access Insights should install this package,
which adds this enhancement.
